ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light gray) central fluke regions contrasted with low-intensity (black) pigmented regions along the trailing edges and terminal tips. Distribution ratio approximately 75% light to 25% dark.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented bands following the trailing edge contour. Dense dark clusters at both lateral tips. Discrete dark focal spots and linear streaks scattered across the mid-region of both lobes. The left lobe displays a dark cluster near the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 82 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Variation amplitude increases towards the distal tips, showing a high density of small-scale peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch towards the tips. Leading edges (partially submerged) appear straight to slightly convex.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters present on the lower-mid region of the left lobe and mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin dark linear disruptions. The right lobe shows at least two prominent parallel diagonal streaks. The left lobe exhibits multiple shorter, unaligned dark lines near the base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable raggedness and loss of geometric integrity at both lateral tips, consistent with historical wear or minor amputation of edge tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: Metadata overlay at the bottom of the frame (TEC03-64/32, ID 11695). A small dark avian silhouette is visible in the background water to the right of the right fluke lobe.
